x: Roger Keyes - who won the London Schools C.C. Champs - has been ably backed up by Jim Tappy and N.

For the boys, Jim Tappy ran a "cracker" on the final leg and was 2nd fastest boy over the course with a time of 10:03. Our quartet also finished 2nd to the Mitcham team and at the same time slaughtered our own Youths reserve team.

Jim Tappy showed some good speed by running home 3rd in the 880yds, in which John Kelly was beaten into 2nd place. Philip Gee romped both sprints with Tony Brooks giving us another 52.0 clocking in the 440yds.
